expected_stdout.symbolic_source: SYMBOLIC IDENTITY FOR EVERY INTEGER s>=1

proved: For every actual p=4h+6s+3 with h,s>=1, the pinned coefficient has the exact parity residue c_h^*=Lambda_s^(-1)(a_s+b_s,epsilon*w_h) mod p.
The exact coefficients a_s and b_s,epsilon are given by the two finite all-s coefficient extractions in the report.
The clearing factor Lambda_s=3*2^(10s+10) is integral and a p-unit on every actual row; its prime support is exactly {2,3}.
A pinned E_h^* zero forces p to divide D_s,epsilon=2^(3s+1)a_s^2-delta_s,epsilon*b_s,epsilon^2.
The Euler signs and eta cases are exact, and D_s,epsilon is a norm in the quadratic etale algebra Q[T]/(T^2-delta*eta).
The rational-source denominator degree is 6s+8 and log max(1,|a|,|b|,|D|)=O(s).
One moving container per s plus quadratic-norm shape and linear logarithmic height, without prime localization, cannot uniformly improve the raw 1/36-per-6M ceiling.

capacity.reason: At fixed M there are M/12+O(1) moving containers with only O(M^2) product-height control; comparison norm containers permit prime mass arbitrarily close to M/6.
